text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @sarah (oncall): dedpool-novus-1 node n-42 entered repeated cold-boot loop. Alert triggered: gpu.node.bootloop (5 occurrences in 2m). Potential tenant impact: increased 5xx and timeouts for NovusHealth VPC.

Sarah (oncall): Got it. I'm looking. Any automated cordon/drain triggered?

toni_sre: Not yet — auto-eviction didn't kick because the node passed health checks before reboot cycle. Seeing OOM/kconfig warnings in syslog.

Sarah (oncall): Ok start a manual cordon and drain for n-42. We need to live-migrate active sessions for NovusHealth and avoid routing new requests.

devops-bot: Command suggestion:
```
redwoodctl nodes annotate n-42 maintenance=true --reason "cold-boot-loop"
redwoodctl nodes cordon n-42
redwoodctl pods migrate --node n-42 --grace-period 30
```

Sarah (oncall): Running commands now.

Sarah (oncall): `redwoodctl nodes annotate n-42 maintenance=true --reason "cold-boot-loop"` -> OK
Sarah (oncall): `redwoodctl nodes cordon n-42` -> OK
Sarah (oncall): `redwoodctl pods migrate --node n-42 --grace-period 30` -> started. 7 inference workers scheduled to evacuate.

mike_hw: I'll start remote console and watch boot logs. Likely a PCIe/firmware regression after last platform update. If we see kernel oops we should RMA.

Elaine-cse: NovusSupport - FYI, we're isolating a GPU node in your dedicated pool to prevent broader impact. We'll live-migrate your workloads and keep you posted. Who's your on-call for escalation?

novus-support: thanks, Elaine. Novus on-call is @raj. Please include us on timeline and any customer-visible degrade windows.

toni_sre: Evac is 90% complete. 2 workers are stuck on long-running inference streams (>300s). We can force terminate but will try graceful first.

Sarah (oncall): Toni, if streams don't finish in 60s, force kill and reschedule. We need the node offline to avoid restart loops.

toni_sre: Force killed the two stuck workers, pods rescheduled to dedpool-novus-2. 100% migration success. Routing layer updated to avoid n-42.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Node n-42 removed from routing pool. Customers should see normal traffic. Monitoring replaying requests queued during migration.

mike_hw: Remote console shows `Machine check exception` followed by immediate reboot. Looks like persistent hardware error during early POST. I can attempt a BIOS reflash and a cold power cycle. If it comes back to same state -> hardware fault.

Sarah (oncall): Do the BIOS reflash + cold power cycle. Document steps. If node returns to bootloop, raise hw-rma and plan for replacement.

mike_hw: Applying BIOS reflash now (image v2.3.1 -> v2.3.0 rollback).

mike_hw: Cold power cycle executed. Observing serial logs... still hitting early POST failure.

mike_hw: Confirmed: node reboots to PEI stage then power-cycles. I recommend RMA. Opening RMA ticket and scheduling replacement.

Sarah (oncall): Create RMA ticket and mark node offline for replacement. Also create a postmortem note for the customer impact window.

mike_hw: RMA ticket opened: RMA-78912. Replacement node requested with expedited shipping. ETA 48h.

Elaine-cse: NovusSupport, update: we've isolated the faulty node, live-migrated your workloads immediately, and replaced routing so there's no ongoing customer impact. Replacement hardware is requested; ETA ~48h. We'll send a post-incident summary when RMA completes.

novus-support: Thanks. Please include any relevant logs and whether any inference requests were lost/failed.

toni_sre: Quick notes for post-incident:
- Impact window: 2123456789 -> 2123456975
- Affected pool: dedpool-novus-1 (node n-42)
- Symptoms: repeated cold reboot at POST, machine check exceptions in early boot logs
- Mitigation: manual cordon + pods migrate, forced termination of 2 stuck workers, routing removal
- Customer-visible: brief spike in 5xx and increased latency for ~3m during migration; no data exfiltration, requests retried by client side mostly succeeded.

Sarah (oncall): I'll draft incident summary and attach logs. Action items:
- mike_hw: follow up on RMA-78912 and replacement coordinate (assigned)
- toni_sre: add runbook note to dedpool runbook about bootloop detection and auto-eviction thresholds (assigned)
- devops-bot: remind to expire maintenance annotation once node replaced

devops-bot: Reminder scheduled: `2024-11-15T09:00:00Z` to check maintenance flags on replaced nodes.

Sarah (oncall): Closing here — monitoring green for Novus. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread closed (status: mitigated).
